commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' The foul by Diego Rico (Getafe) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Mateo Busquets.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
83' A goal, which was scored by Manor Solomon (Villarreal), was disallowed due to offside.
80' A substitution has been made. Mauro Arambarri is replaced by Hugo Solozabal (Getafe).
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is replacing Tajon Buchanan.
80' That will be all from Georges Mikautadze who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal).
75' Today's match ends for Adrian Liso who will be replaced by Abu Kamara (Getafe).
74' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alex Sancris (Getafe) replacing Kiko Femenia.
74' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Domingos Duarte is replaced by Abdel Abqar (Getafe).
74' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) has a goal ruled out for offside!
73' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
71' Mateo Busquets shows the yellow card to Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) for a heavy challenge.
70' Marcelino has decided to substitute Ayoze Perez and he is replaced by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal).
70' Substitution. Manor Solomon (Villarreal) in, Alberto Moleiro out.
64' 2 - 0 Goal! Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) gets to the ball inside the box, sees the goalkeeper off his line and lifts the ball over him and into the back of the net. 2:0.
62' Carlos Macia (Villarreal) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Mateo Busquets didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
62' Total attempts – 6:6.
57' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
54' Good work from Getafe as they win a corner.
51' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dani Parejo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Carlos Macia (Villarreal).

48' What is going on? At first it seemed that Luis Milla (Getafe) would get away without any booking, then all of a sudden Mateo Busquets pulls out a red card! Luis Milla (Getafe) must have said something really inappropriate! He is sent off!

47' Luis Milla (Getafe) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has made a change at the break. Diego Rico (Getafe) has come on in place of Allan Nyom.
46' Referee Mateo Busquets blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+5' 1 - 0 Goal! Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the left post.
45+4' Jose Bordalas Jimenez isn't happy on the touchline after referee Mateo Busquets shows him a yellow card.
45+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mario Martin (Getafe) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+2' Villarreal will take a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
42' Adrian Liso (Getafe) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

39' A decent save by David Soria. Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Mateo Busquets has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ayoze Perez (Villarreal).
37' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
32' Allan Nyom (Getafe) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
30' Wasted opportunity. Allan Nyom (Getafe) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
30' Getafe get a corner.
29' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Villarreal for a penalty. Play continues.
28' Luis Milla (Getafe) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Mateo Busquets stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
27' The ball is cleared after Allan Nyom (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Allan Nyom (Getafe), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
21' The total number of attempts is 1:1.
19' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) brings an opponent down and Mateo Busquets interrupts the game.
17' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) latches onto a cross and drills a shot towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.
13' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) trips an opposition player and Mateo Busquets signals a foul.
11' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in.
11' Corner kick. Villarreal will have an opportunity.
11' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.
8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.
7' The game is interrupted. Domingos Duarte (Getafe) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
5' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
5' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but David Soria pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
3' Mario Martin (Getafe) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Getafe will kick-off.
Mateo Busquets is introduced as the referee for today's match.
